title: He Healed Ten Lepers. Only One Said Thank You.
description:
Ten lepers cried out to Jesus and all ten were healed. Only one came back to say thank you. Luke 17 asks a question that still lands at our tables every Thanksgiving: where are the nine?

This is a Thanksgiving word from the Bible, in the King James Version. We open in Psalm 107, then walk through Luke 17 and the one Samaritan who turned around. The Bible never says where the nine went. We talk about why most of us would have been one of them, how a thank you slips out of a busy week, and what Paul traced back to a missing thank you in Romans 1.

From there we look at David telling his own soul to forget not all His benefits, and at Philippians 4, where the thanks sits right in the middle of the asking. We also stay with 1 Thessalonians 5:18, the verse people throw at you on a bad week, and the little word in it: in every thing, not for every thing. If there is an empty chair at your table this year, or you worked last night so someone else could have today off, this one is for you too.

We close with two things to do today and a prayer of thanks in the name of Jesus. If this blessed you, type amen below and send it to someone who needs it.

CHAPTERS
0:00 When did you last say thank you?
0:47 Psalm 107: give thanks unto the LORD
2:03 The ten lepers (Luke 17)
3:16 Where are the nine?
4:15 David: forget not all his benefits
5:26 Romans 1: neither were thankful
5:56 Philippians 4: thanks in the asking
7:13 In every thing give thanks
8:28 Two things to do today
9:06 A prayer of thanks

SCRIPTURE (KJV)
Psalm 107:1: "O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever."
Luke 17:17: "And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?"
Philippians 4:6-7: "Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus."
1 Thessalonians 5:18: "In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you."

Blessed Prayers shares the Word of God for everyday life. The narration voice is AI-generated and the footage is licensed stock.
